title: The heifer sacrifice symbolizes Jesus' sacrifice; water of cleansing
summary: A text slide explaining the red heifer as a symbol: the heifer sacrifice points to the divine sacrifice of Jesus Christ, the red heifer and scarlet wool point to Jesus' blood, a heifer as a female life-giver points to the life-giving force of His atonement, and the water of cleansing symbolizes purification of a defiled person.

text.text: The sacrifice of the Heifer is symbolic of Jesus Christ’s divine sacrifice;
Red Heifer & Scarlet Wool point to Jesus’ blood
A Heifer is a female and potential life-giver which points to the life-giving force of Jesus’ atonement.
Water of cleansing pertains to the symbolic purification of the defiled person.
Water physically cleanses a person with dirty hands, Water of cleansing ritually purifies a defiled soul.

keywords: heifer is a type of Christ
